archetypes.name: dyn-adoption-baseline
archetypes.rationale: Verify AST binding resolution, run_rule exemption, and baseline-io helper indirection against false positives.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect lint_engine_adoption.py detect logic for ArgumentParser alias resolution, main-reachable run_rule exemption, and *-baseline.json path flow including same-module helpers. Confirm one finding per class, fixed anchors/messages, and that engine-backed modules remain clean while lint_keyword_only alias debt is covered. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
